opening.argument: The video presents a tutorial-style walkthrough of a cryptocurrency-reward app, showing sign-in options, a referral-code screen, and activities that generate points. Users can receive an Energy Point for watching a video and points for completing a survey, while the referral screen describes sharing friends' profit. The claim flow expressly distinguishes points from Satoshi and permits withdrawals only every three days. These conditions make the reward structure more qualified than a direct promise of equivalent cryptocurrency. The material does not establish that any payout was completed, what the points are worth, or that the app makes a deceptive guarantee. Its promotional language is limited to inviting users to download the app to earn bitcoins.
